test.title: Mini-test · Flats and houses to rent

paragraphs.text: One-bedroom flat above a shop, two minutes from the railway station. £750 a month, bills not included. Available now. No pets. Street parking only.
Two bedrooms on the third floor of a building with a lift. £920 a month including heating and water. Shared garden. Available from 1 September. Minimum tenancy twelve months.
One bedroom on the ground floor with a private garden. £800 a month. Pets will be considered. Kitchen fitted this year. Twenty minutes’ walk to the town centre.
A studio flat with river views, suitable for one person. £620 a month. Fully furnished. Gym and bicycle storage in the building. Available for six months only.
A double room in a house shared with three professionals. £550 a month including all bills and internet. A cleaner visits weekly for the shared areas. Non-smokers only.
A three-bedroom house with a driveway for two cars. £1,200 a month. Close to two primary schools. Unfurnished. Available from October.

items.prompt: is available for a short fixed period
has space to park more than one car
may accept tenants who have animals
requires tenants to stay for at least a year
is in a building with a lift

groups.instruction: Questions 1–10. Look at the six advertisements, A–F. Which advertisement mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–F. NB You may use any letter more than once.
